summary.text: Ben Harrison is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 2 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Rick Pressnell is also on the ballot. A business owner, Harrison earned an engineering degree from Auburn University.

paragraphs.text: Harrison graduated from West Limestone High School in 1978 and earned a degree in engineering from Auburn University.
His career experience includes founding a business and working as a technical services manager for Kohler.
Harrison won the Republican nomination for the open District 2 seat in 2022, defeating Jason Black in a June 21, 2022 primary runoff, and won the general election that November.
He assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Lynn Greer.

In the 2025-2026 session Harrison was assigned to the Constitution, Campaigns and Elections; County and Municipal Government; Fiscal Responsibility; Limestone County Legislation; and Military and Veterans' Affairs committees.
